title: Getting around
text: WASD moves, the mouse aims. Shift sprints, C crouches. Crouching is slow but quiet.

title: Searching
text: Press E at a container to search it. It takes a moment and makes a little noise; moving or getting hit stops you. The loot window opens as soon as you're done.

title: Hungry
text: Your hunger is low. Open the inventory (Tab) and eat something. At zero you start losing health.

title: Thirsty
text: Your thirst is low. Drink something from the inventory (Tab). Dirty water should be boiled at a stove first.

title: Locked
text: Hold E to pick the lock if you carry a lockpick: quiet and slow. Hold Shift+E to force it with a crowbar: fast and loud. Some locks need a key.

title: Night falls
text: At night you see less, and zombies are more numerous and faster. F toggles the flashlight, but it makes you easier to spot.

title: Bleeding
text: You're bleeding. Use a bandage before it adds up. Bandages are crafted from cloth rags (Tab → Craft).

title: Infected
text: A bite got infected. It worsens over days. Antibiotics knock it back; left untreated, it kills.

title: Encumbered
text: You're carrying more than you can manage: slower, and no sprinting. Drop something, stash it, or find a backpack.

title: Distractions
text: Select a bottle with 4 and press G (or click) to throw it. Zombies go to check out the noise.

title: Noise
text: Everything you do makes noise; the meter shows how loud you are. Zombies hear it. Broken glass underfoot is loud.

title: Fighting
text: Click to swing. An unaware zombie hit from behind takes triple damage. Space shoves when you're surrounded.

title: Crafting
text: Tab opens crafting for simple items. Weapons and mods need a workbench (E). Blueprints unlock new recipes.

title: Broken weapon
text: That weapon broke. Repair it at a workbench, or dismantle it for parts.

title: The world map
text: Walking costs time, and time costs food and water. Some places are too far to walk.

title: Bartering
text: Money is worthless. Offer goods worth at least what you take. Anything extra stays with the trader as credit.

title: Journal
text: J opens the journal. The tracked objective is shown at the top right.

title: The bunk
text: Sleep to pass time and heal slowly. Sleeping saves the game.

title: Reloading
text: R reloads from your reserve ammo. The shotgun loads one shell at a time.

title: Quick slots
text: In the inventory, assign food or medicine to quick slots 5–8 for one-key use.

title: Zombies
text: They see in a cone in front of them and they hear everything. Crouch (C) and come from behind.

title: Hurt
text: Your health is low. Eat well to regenerate slowly, or use painkillers and first-aid kits.

title: Food poisoning
text: Raw food or unboiled water made you sick. It passes, but it hurts. Charcoal tablets settle it.

title: Driving
text: The ambulance is yours. On the world map, travel by vehicle: much faster, fewer encounters, but it burns fuel.
